hunts.title: The Lost Treasure
hunts.description: Begin ur journey and discover the first hidden treasure

clues.question: I have hands but cannot clap. What am I?
clues.hint: You can check the time with me.

clues.question: I have keys but open no locks. I have space but no room. What am I?
clues.hint: You use me to type on a computer.

clues.question: Complete the sequence: 2, 4, 8, 16, ?
clues.hint: Each number is multiplied by 2.

clues.question: I speak without a mouth and hear without ears. I have no body, but I come alive with wind.
clues.hint: You may hear me after shouting in the mountains.

clues.question: What gets wetter as it dries?
clues.hint: You use it after taking a bath.

hunts.title: Mystery of the Hidden Room
hunts.description: A secret room is waiting. Solve every puzzle to unlock it.

clues.question: I am tall when I am young and short when I am old. What am I?
clues.hint: I give light while slowly becoming smaller.

clues.question: What has one eye but cannot see?
clues.hint: It is used with thread.

clues.question: Unscramble these letters: R E T A W
clues.hint: It is essential for life.

clues.question: A man looks at a portrait and says: Brothers and sisters I have none, but this man's father is my father's son. Who is in the portrait?
clues.hint: The speaker's father's son is the speaker himself.

clues.question: What room has no doors or windows?
clues.hint: Think of a word that contains room.

hunts.title: Missing Diamond
hunts.description: A precious diamond has disappeared. Follow the clues and find it.

clues.question: I have cities but no houses, forests but no trees, and rivers but no water. What am I?
clues.hint: You use me to find places.

clues.question: Complete the sequence: 3, 6, 12, 24, ?
clues.hint: Each number is doubled.

clues.question: What can travel around the world while staying in one corner?
clues.hint: You can find me on an envelope.

clues.question: I am full of holes but I can still hold water. What am I?
clues.hint: You may use me while cleaning.

clues.question: Which month has 28 days?
clues.hint: Every month has at least 28 days.

hunts.title: Secret of the Ancient Library
hunts.description: An ancient library hides a secret message.

clues.question: I am taken from a mine and shut inside a wooden case. What am I?
clues.hint: You can find me inside a pencil.

clues.question: What has many branches but no fruit, trunk, or leaves?
clues.hint: People keep money here.

clues.question: A farmer has 17 sheep. All but 9 run away. How many sheep remain?
clues.hint: Read the words 'all but 9' carefully.

clues.question: Take the first letter of each word: Secret Ancient Maps Exist.
clues.hint: Use the first letter of every word.

clues.question: I have a head and a tail but no body. What am I?
clues.hint: You can find me in your pocket.

hunts.title: The Final Mystery
hunts.description: The final treasure is near. Solve the hardest mysteries.

clues.question: If two's company and three's a crowd, what are four and five?
clues.hint: Add four and five.

clues.question: A clock strikes 6 in 5 seconds. How many seconds does it take to strike 12?
clues.hint: Six strikes have five intervals.

clues.question: I am always in front of you but can never be seen. What am I?
clues.hint: It has not happened yet.

clues.question: What number comes next: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, ?
clues.hint: Add the previous two numbers.

clues.question: The more you take, the more you leave behind. What are they?
clues.hint: Think about walking.
